hook: Nothing can drive across the Crimean Bridge
caption:
🌉 Ukraine hit the Crimean Bridge two nights in a row; the road section is out of use.
🤝 Trump meets Xi and Putin together Thursday, a first-ever three-way meeting.
🛰️ Iran fired drones at a US radar in Bahrain; intercepted, no damage.
💻 New US limits on AI chip exports hit tech stocks. Hold tech funds? Expect swings around Nvidia's earnings this week.
🦀 Millions of red crabs are on the move on Christmas Island.

Which story surprised you most?

1/5 Crimean Bridge road cut (19 km)
Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge two nights in a row. Kyiv says no car can cross; traffic is suspended.

2/5 Trump, Xi, Putin: one table (1st)
Trump meets Xi and Putin together Thursday in Shenzhen. First-ever three-way talks; nukes and Iran on the agenda.
📷 Vikarna (CC BY-SA 4.0) via wikimedia

3/5 Iran drones target US radar (0 hurt)
Iran fired drones at a US radar base in Bahrain. Intercepted, no damage, amid talks via Oman and Qatar.

4/5 US tightens AI chip exports (-2.49%)
US now needs licences for AI chips to 5 more countries. It targets China renting compute abroad; Nasdaq fell 2.49%.
📷 Steve Jurvetson (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

5/5 Christmas Island turns red (Crabs)
Millions of red crabs began their annual migration. It sweeps across Australia's Christmas Island every year.
